coverage.method: No numerical cap. Variants stay with their maxim; indexes use short topic summaries and link to original wording. Authorship, primary text, interview, remembered speech, paraphrase, and unlocated primary attribution remain distinct.
coverage.anthology_additional_coverage: Unnumbered worldview illustrations and editorial notes; no unique-maxim total asserted.
coverage.epistemology_audit_limit: All main propositions plus selected subnotes; not a claim to index every one of the 80 notes.
coverage.luhmann_numbering_gap: 04 not located; 0.5 preserved; 00 repeated once but counted once.
coverage.no_grand_total_reason: The collections repeat and reformulate ideas, incorporate others’ work, and include equations or diagrams. Adding their item counts would misrepresent the number of distinct HvF maxims.

review.method: Independent primary and reported-source reviews; quotations checked per authored work, including mirrors and multiple page entries.
